title: Disentangling and Operationalizing AI Fairness at LinkedIn
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any benchmarks related to faith or religion. The work describes a framework that could theoretically be applied to religion as a demographic category, but the actual case study presented focuses on gender bias.
findings: The paper does not contain findings related to religion. 'Religion' is mentioned a single time as an example of a demographic grouping for which fairness could be assessed, but it is not included in any of the paper's analyses, measurements, or case studies. The empirical work presented focuses exclusively on binary gender.
